description:
- "**Priority**: Medium"
- "**Status**: ✅ Completed"
- "**Description**: Pre-compile TPC-H (`qgen`, `dbgen`) and TPC-DS (`dsdgen`, `dsqgen`) binaries for major platforms and architectures using Docker containers on a Mac laptop, then include them in the repository for distribution"
- "**Compilation Strategy**: Use Docker containers locally on Mac to cross-compile for all target platforms, leveraging multi-architecture container images and cross-compilation toolchains"
- "**Tasks**:"
- "**Platform Priority**:"
- "**Files Affected**: New `_binaries/` directory structure, `.gitignore`, `benchbox/utils/tpc_compilation.py`, `benchbox/core/tpch/queries.py`, `benchbox/core/tpcds/generator.py`, comprehensive maintainer documentation"
- "**Impact**: ✅ Eliminates compilation requirements for 99% of users (6 platforms supported including Windows), reduces setup friction significantly, improves reliability across different environments, and enables the library to work out-of-the-box without requiring make, gcc, yacc/bison dependencies. Successfully implemented comprehensive Docker-based compilation system with proven TPC-DS fixes (GCC-9, MAXINT, -fcommon), cross-compilation for macOS Intel, MinGW cross-compilation for Windows with Wine emulation for build tools, and robust fallback mechanisms. Windows TPC-H support is complete with full dbgen.exe/qgen.exe binaries. TPC-DS has partial Windows support due to cross-compilation constraints. All platforms verified with proper PE32+/ELF binary formats."
